caption:
Consultants leave. Dashboards refresh. The recommendation that started it all is never revisited.

Growth Terminal commits a baseline before the work starts, then compares it against what actually happened and records one of three verdicts: worked, missed, or not enough evidence.

→ growthterminal.io
first_comment: Two of the three verdicts are not good news. That is the point. A tool that can only tell you it worked is not measuring anything.
alt_text: Poster reading: Nobody ever came back and told you if it worked.
